name: COL Digital Publishing Group Co., Ltd.
summary: COL Digital Publishing Group Co., Ltd. is a Chinese company primarily engaged in the digital publishing industry. In addition to its core publishing activities, it also develops and maintains digital reading platforms for a broad range of educational institutions, encompassing primary schools, secondary schools, and universities. The organization previously operated under the name ChineseAll Digital Publishing Group Co.,Ltd. until it officially rebranded to COL Digital Publishing Group Co., Ltd. in September 2019. Established in 2000, the company's headquarters are situated in Beijing, China.
